note: Batch 2 = exercises Aziz logs in Strong that are not in batch 1. Same format and rules as batch 1 (primary red #d9392c, secondary amber #f0a030).

exercises.equipment: Lat pulldown station with a straight bar, seat and thigh pad, underhand (palms facing you) shoulder-width grip
exercises.camera: from behind and slightly to the side
exercises.technique: Seated with thighs under the pad; underhand grip about shoulder width; the bar pulls to the upper chest with elbows driving down and back, then rises slowly to full stretch.

exercises.equipment: High row machine: chest pad, high handles that pull down and back
exercises.technique: Chest against the pad; handles start high in front and pull down and back toward the ribs with the elbows driving back; return to a full stretch.

exercises.equipment: Seated shoulder press machine: seat, back pad, two handles at shoulder height that press up
exercises.technique: Back on the pad; handles start at shoulder height and press up to near lockout, then lower to shoulder height; hands on the handles.

exercises.equipment: Smith machine with an upright bench behind the bar, barbell on vertical rails
exercises.technique: Seated upright on the bench; the bar starts at chin height in front of the face and presses overhead along the rails, then lowers to chin height.

exercises.equipment: Smith machine with an incline bench (about 30 degrees), barbell on vertical rails
exercises.technique: Back on the incline bench, feet planted; the bar lowers to the upper chest and presses up along the rails; hands grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
exercises.source: Strong: Incline Bench Press (Smith Machine), 39 workouts

exercises.equipment: 45-degree leg press: seat with back pad, sled with foot platform, safety stops
exercises.technique: Back flat on the pad; feet shoulder width on the platform; knees bend to about 90 degrees (no hips lifting) and press back to near lockout without locking the knees.

exercises.equipment: Seated row machine: chest pad, seat, two handles at chest height with a wide grip option
exercises.technique: Chest against the pad; handles pulled back to the ribs with the elbows out wide, shoulder blades squeezed, then returned to a full stretch.

exercises.equipment: Seated leg curl machine: seat, back pad, thigh pad, ankle pad on a lever
exercises.technique: Seated with the thigh pad locked down; heels curl down and back under the seat, then return slowly to nearly straight.

exercises.equipment: Cable at head height with a rope attachment, standing
exercises.technique: Rope pulled to the face with the elbows high and wide, hands ending beside the ears, then returned to full extension.

exercises.equipment: Plate-loaded shoulder press machine: seat, back pad, lever arms with handles and weight plates
exercises.technique: Back on the pad; handles press up and slightly together to near lockout then lower to shoulder height; the lever arms move with the hands.

exercises.equipment: Smith machine, barbell on vertical rails, standing
exercises.technique: Standing with the bar at the upper chest; press straight up along the rails to lockout overhead, then lower to the upper chest.

exercises.equipment: Pull-up bar or captain chair; hanging with straight arms
exercises.technique: Hanging with straight arms; the legs raise together with control to hip height or higher by curling the pelvis, then lower slowly without swinging.
Hips on the pad, feet anchored; the torso lowers with a straight back to about 90 degrees at the hips and raises to a straight line with the legs, not past it.
Elbows at the sides, bar curls from the thighs up to shoulder height and lowers under control; hands on the angled grips.
Back on the bench, feet planted; dumbbells lower to chest level with the elbows about 45 degrees from the torso and press up over the chest.

exercises.equipment: Plate-loaded iso-lateral chest press: seat, back pad, lever arms with handles and weight plates
exercises.technique: Back on the pad, handles at mid-chest; press forward to near lockout and return to a full stretch; each arm moves its own lever.
exercises.source: Strong: Iso-Lateral Chest Press (Machine), 92 workouts (assumed plate-loaded)
